label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Esta torá del animal y del ave y de toda alma la viva la reptante en las aguas, y a toda alma la reptante sobre la tierra,
spanish: Esta ley del animal y del ave y de toda alma viviente la reptante en las aguas, y a toda alma la pululante sobre la tierra,
grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated Hebraized lemma 'torá' (H8451, תּוֹרַת, construct) to the Spanish common noun 'ley', matching this project's established rendering of the same construct noun elsewhere in Levítico ('esta ley del pecado', 'esta ley de la culpa', 'esta ley de sacrificio').

Replaced the second 'la reptante' (h03011046012, הַשֹּׁרֶצֶת H8317: wriggle/swarm/abound) with 'la pululante' so it no longer duplicates 'la reptante', which stays for הָרֹמֶשֶׂת (H7430: creep/glide, h03011046008). This matches the project's existing rendering of this שרץ participle as pulular (cf. Levítico 11:20, 11:23, 11:41).

Replaced the calque 'alma la viva' with 'alma viviente' for the construct נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּ֔ה (h03011046006/h03011046007) to state the construct link, matching this corpus's consistent rendering of the identical Hebrew construct phrase elsewhere (e.g. Génesis 1:20, 1:21, 1:24, 1:30, 9:12, 9:15, 9:16).
readerNote: Chose 'alma viviente' over the literal 'alma la viva' to carry the נֶפֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּה construct link, matching this corpus's consistent rendering of that same phrase elsewhere.
